supersedes_note: Task 51 supersedes Task 49. Numeric byte ceilings remain the inherited safety limits; chunk topology is now informational so deliberate simplification may remove or merge optional lazy chunks.

rules.chunk_identity: emitted file name with only the terminal content hash stripped
rules.missing_optional_budgeted_chunk: reported; does not fail because removal or merging may be an intentional architecture simplification
rules.unknown_chunk_below_threshold: reported as untracked_small_chunks; does not fail
rules.chunk_count_mismatch: reported against the historical baseline; does not fail

formulas.clamp: index.js is clamped by the Task 51 locked ceiling of 550000; BasicLeafEditor.js and markdown.js remain clamped by their unchanged locked ceilings when those chunks are emitted

locked_ceilings.note: These remain byte ceilings, not a requirement that historical optional chunks keep existing. The startup chunk is mandatory; optional lazy chunks may disappear or merge as the product architecture is simplified.

task_51_notes: Historical measurements are retained as ceilings and comparison evidence, not as a requirement to preserve the old screen architecture.

The current gate requires the main startup chunk, enforces aggregate raw/gzip ceilings, enforces per-chunk ceilings for known chunks when emitted, rejects duplicate normalized identities, and rejects new unbudgeted chunks at or above the threshold.
Optional lazy chunks may disappear or merge when product simplification removes their front-end path; that reduction is reported and is not a regression.
The historical expected_chunk_count remains baseline information only.
